technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Aircraft operation modelled based on passenger aircrafts operated by Lufthansa Group in 2019. The emission profiles distinguish between LTO and cruise.

# Included processes
The dataset describes the operation of aircrafts including taxying, take-off and landing covering fuel consumption and operation emissions. Aircraft manufacture and maintenance, airport construction, operation and dismantling are inputs to this dataset

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: fuel consumption is based on corporate data, emission profiles are based on FOEN statistics
